taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: H-type (ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 < ρ4 < ρ5 < ρ6, with the resistivity minimum at Layer 3)
Aquifer depth: 18.02 – 20.11 m
Recommendation: Plan the screen interval to target the low-resistivity zone (105–60 Ω·m) between about 18 m and 20 m depth, which is sandwiched between more resistive units and likely represents a saturated, fine-grained water-bearing horizon; confirm lithology with cuttings/logging while drilling since this zone is thin (~2 m) and may require careful screen placement to avoid short-circuiting with the overlying or underlying resistive beds.
